smell: Detector hit: top-level `S.decodeEffect(S.UnknownFromJsonString)` feeding `parseJson` looks like a free-floating decoder wall.

exception.reason: This is the JSON trust-boundary decoder for file/URL-loaded attacker-controlled text; `parseJson` maps schema failure into DatasetLoadError with the source location and safe message. `withCodecStatics` exposes only is/fromUnknown/decodeOption, not the Effect-returning decoder shape required here.
exception.boundary: No trust-boundary weakening; keep explicit JSON decode plus DatasetLoadError mapping at the loader boundary.

smell: Detector hit: top-level `S.decodeResult(S.UnknownFromJsonString)` and `parseLine(line, lineNumber)` look like separated decode behavior.

exception.reason: The decoder is intentionally scoped to the JSONL boundary so parse failures can be converted into JsonlLineError with the physical line number while preserving skipInvalid/result-stream semantics. Codec statics would not carry the required line-number context.
exception.boundary: Streaming JSONL parse boundary; structured per-line error context is load-bearing.
